name: deck-sample
text:
Unit 5 Quick Check

Part 1. Choose the best answer.
1. She ___ in Hanoi since 2019.
A. lives
B. has lived *
C. lived
D. is living
2. I ___ him yesterday at the station.
A. saw *
B. have seen
C. see
D. was seeing
3. They ___ the report yet.
A. didn't finish
B. haven't finished *
C. don't finish
D. hadn't finished
4. How long ___ you known each other?
A. do
B. did
C. have
D. are

Part 2. Decide if each statement is True, False or Not given.
Green space pays for itself. Homes that overlook a park sell for up to 15 per cent more than similar homes a few streets away.
5. Homes near parks always sell for 15 per cent more.
Answer: False
6. Parks are cheaper to build than roads.
Answer: Not given
7. Trees can cool streets in summer.

Part 3. Write ONE word in each gap.
8. We have lived here ___ 2015.
9. She has worked here ___ three years.
10. Have you ever ___ to Da Nang?

Answer key: 8-since 9-for 10-been
